claim.text: The struck vehicle became a hazard at 6.1333 s with hazard onset reason closing.
Time-to-collision at hazard onset was 1.9427 s.
Perception took 0.119 s from hazard onset to first detection, below the 0.3 s perception threshold.
The system handed off to the driver 1.0228 s after first detection.
Only 0.7249 s remained from handoff to impact, less than the 1.5 s human perception-response time.
The CAN brake request occurred at 8.7817 s, which was 0.7817 s after impact.
Brake pressure was reached 0.14 s after the CAN brake request, below the 0.25 s actuation threshold.
With nominal perception 0.2 s, nominal command 0.05 s, and nominal brake tau 0.15 s, the counterfactual replay reported no contact.
